title: Netra Error Payload
$comment: The server_to_client `error` message type's payload. Approved 2026-09-12 alongside session.snapshot and quiz.question (see docs/architecture/message-flow.md). request_id is deliberately NOT a field here: the envelope already carries request_id at the top level (both protocol schemas require it), and duplicating it in-payload would only create a second place the two values could disagree. code is drawn from a fixed, closed vocabulary so the client can branch on it without ever parsing message text; message is safe accessible wording only, never an exception's own text, a stack trace, SQL, or a provider payload.

message.$comment: Safe, accessible wording only. Never exception text, a stack trace, SQL, provider response bodies, or another account's resource identifiers.

retryable.$comment: Whether resending the SAME request_id could succeed. SESSION_VERSION_CONFLICT and REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT are not retryable as-is: the client must reconcile (fetch session.snapshot, mint a new request_id) before trying again.

current_session_version.$comment: Present when code is SESSION_VERSION_CONFLICT, giving the client the actual version to reconcile against without a separate round trip. Absent otherwise.

correlation_id.$comment: Opaque server-side trace/log correlation id for support use. Not a resource identifier and never used by the client to infer existence of anything.

details.$comment: Optional, narrowly-constructed safe facts already known to the application (e.g. {"field": "expected_session_version"} for INVALID_REQUEST). Never an exception dictionary, provider response, stack trace, SQL error, or arbitrary validation internals. Omit entirely rather than serialize anything unvetted.
